description: Say whether people in other cities are in work, awake, or sleep at a moment. Use for "3pm for me — can I ping Bangalore?". myTime defaults to now. Pass myTimezone as an IANA id or myCity as a place. Paste shareText. A rough window includes a plannerUrl with better aiSlots.

_endUserId.description: Optional opaque per-call end-user attribution token populated by the MCP host, not the LLM. Use a non-PII hash or token; never send raw email, name, or platform user ID.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD when myTime is only a clock time.

durationMinutes.description: Optional. Only 30, 45, or 60 are written onto the planner link.

myCity.description: Caller city, used when myTimezone is omitted.

myTime.description: ISO instant, or a floating local time in myTimezone. Defaults to now.

myTimezone.description: IANA timezone for the caller, such as America/Los_Angeles.

anyOf.description: One or more cities or timezones to judge.
One or more cities or timezones to judge.

theirCity.description: One city or timezone to judge.

workEnd.description: Last in-hours local hour, inclusive. Default 18.

name: are_they_awake
